why: A (universes 0) has three conjuncts. isotropyHom_mem_trivialSet_iff: for F only a local sc-diffeomorphism on objects, F(g) ∈ T_{Fx} ↔ g ∈ T_x. bijective_isotropyHom: for an equivalence, g ↦ F(g) is bijective G_x → G_{Fx}. remark_10_1_12: the remark, with value (ψ∘F g)∘ψ⁻¹ and e g ∈ T_y ↔ g ∈ T_x. B is the remark with IsEquivB, value ψ∘(F g∘ψ⁻¹) and trivialSubgroup (its carrier is trivialSet, Iff.rfl). A_to_B and the remark_10_1_12 part of B_to_A only reassociate and use the glue isEquivB_iff. bijective_isotropyHom follows from B with y = F x, ψ = 1_{Fx}: the isomorphism is then g ↦ F g. isotropyHom_mem_trivialSet_iff concerns functors that need not be equivalences, which B does not cover. It is re-proved outright (the project's proof, from the non-item lemmas mor_mem_nonEffectivePart and mem_nonEffectivePart_of_mor), without the hypothesis. On the remark itself the two sides agree.
